Dear Martin,
I hope all is well with you. I'm Sambath, and I'll be supporting you on this case from expert team. After having a detailed analysis, I observed that the EcoG( SECC- with 10.20.17.100 | KF11) became faulty on this charger, leading to Outlet 2 going out of order.  Please be aware that we are working on RCA for EcoG failure and requesting that you send the faulty unit back to the factory for analysis. Request you to replace the SECC with new one to resolve the issue.
Spare Required:
Thank you very much for being understanding and patient.
